lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.19 - A. Look and write

details: Look and write checks understanding of new vocabulary. Write tests students’ ability to write a word or phrase correctly using clues and visuals.
Look for correct choices, accurate spelling and careful penmanship.
“I love making photo albums to remind me of all the fun things I’ve done. Have a look at some of my pictures!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.20 - Speaking Toss a coin. Then ask & answer

details: Ask and answer gives students practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions in a fun context of a board game to build confidence.
Look for correct use of the question, clear and accurate answers and turn taking.
